class.name: VisibilityCullerExtension
class.brief_description: Lets a GDExtension hide 3D instances that passed Godot's own culling.
class.description: Implement [method _cull] in a GDExtension and register the culler with [method RenderingServer.set_visibility_culler] to add your own culling (for example occlusion culling against a depth buffer from a previous frame) to every 3D cull pass: the camera pass of each viewport, each directional shadow cascade and each positional shadow pass. The culler only sees geometry instances that passed Godot's culling (layers, frustum, visibility ranges) and can only hide them. Instances with [member GeometryInstance3D.ignore_occlusion_culling] enabled, or with [method RenderingServer.instance_set_ignore_culling] enabled, are never passed to it. Lights, decals, reflection probes and other non-geometry instances aren't either, nor are the passes that render reflection probes. [b]Note:[/b] [method _cull] is called on the rendering thread (see [member ProjectSettings.rendering/driver/threads/thread_model]), one pass after another, never concurrently.

method.name: _cull
method.description: Called once per cull pass with the [param count] instances that passed Godot's culling in this pass. [param pass] is a [enum Pass] value, [param viewport] the viewport being rendered. For shadow passes, [param light] is the light's instance RID (as returned by [method VisualInstance3D.get_instance]) and [param index] the cascade ([constant PASS_DIRECTIONAL_SHADOW]), the cube map face or paraboloid half (omni lights) or [code]0[/code]. [param light] is empty and [param index] [code]0[/code] for [constant PASS_CAMERA]. [param transform] and [param projection] are the pass's camera or shadow camera. Omni lights using dual paraboloid shadows and area lights pass an identity [param projection]. [param bounds] holds 6 [float]s per instance, its world-space axis-aligned bounding box: minimum x, y and z, then maximum x, y and z ([code]double[/code]s in double precision builds). [param visible] holds one byte per instance, all [code]1[/code] on entry: set an instance's byte to [code]0[/code] to leave it out of this pass. Both pointers are only valid during the call.

constants.constant: The camera pass of a viewport.
An omni, spot or area light's shadow pass. Positional shadows are only redrawn when they change, so an instance hidden here can stay missing from the shadow until its next update.
